summary: Iteration 4 (Apple App Store compliance + auth code + Google/YouTube removal) fully validated. Backend: 17/17 pytest passed. Frontend: GDPR consent modal, register with age+CGU checkboxes, 6-digit code verification, login without Google button, Add tab link-only, report modal, block user button, Settings 'Utilisateurs bloqués' section — all working end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844).

notes: Deprecation warnings only (non-blocking): 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow) and props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Appear on all pages. Should be cleaned up in a future pass.

action_items: (Optional) Migrate 'shadow*' style props to boxShadow and props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents to remove RN Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/auth/register correctly blocks when age_confirmed is missing/false (400 with FR message)
POST /api/auth/register on existing unverified email rotates the verification code and resends it
POST /api/auth/verify-code increments verification_attempts and returns 429 after 5 wrong attempts
POST /api/auth/resend-code enforces a 30s cooldown (429) and rejects already-verified emails (400)
POST /api/auth/login returns 403 with 'EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED' for unverified users AND regenerates a code
Removed endpoints confirmed absent: /api/auth/google-session, /api/youtube/search, /api/youtube/trending all return 404
POST /api/reports validates content_type (rating|comment|user), requires auth (401), returns report_id
POST /api/users/{id}/block, DELETE /api/users/{id}/block, GET /api/users/me/blocked full round-trip works and self-blocking returns 400
Blocked user's rating is excluded from GET /api/videos/discover (verified end-to-end via block → rate → discover query)
Frontend register page: age-checkbox and terms-checkbox testIDs present; validation message shown when unchecked
verify-code screen: 6-digit input (testID verify-code-input), resend button with visible 30s countdown ('Renvoyer le code (29s)')
Login page: no 'Continuer avec Google' button; testcode@example.com/test123 signs in and lands on the tabs home
Add tab: single YouTube URL field only (no Recherche/Tendances). Paste of Rick Astley URL fetches title/thumbnail and shows star rating UI

Video detail page: report-rating-btn opens modal with reasons (haineux, harcèlement, sexuel, violence, spam, usurpation), successful submit shows 'Signalement envoyé' confirmation and offers 'Bloquer <user>'
Settings screen shows 'UTILISATEURS BLOQUÉS' section (empty state 'Aucun utilisateur bloqué' rendered correctly)
seed_data_creation: Test users prefixed 'TEST_*@example.com' created during pytest (register + verify via DB code). No production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 4 features (App Store compliance UGC signalement/block/age/CGU, GDPR consent modal, email code verification, removal of Google login and YouTube search/trending) verified on both backend (pytest_iter4.xml) and frontend UI at 390x844. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_new_features_iter4.py reads codes directly from MongoDB via mongosh — reusable for regressions. Only leftover: non-blocking RN Web deprecation warnings ('shadow*' props, pointerEvents prop).
